33: k_cancer_test <- function(dset, specificity=0.99, size=1000){

35:     gset <- dset %>% group_by(site)

37:     tset <- gset %>% summarize(prevs=value[feature == 'prevalence'],
38:                                tests=value[feature == 'prevalence']*
39:                                      value[feature == 'sensitivity'] *
40:                                      (1-value[feature == 'localization']))

43:     iset <- gset %>% summarize(cancers=value[feature == 'prevalence']*
44:                                        value[feature == 'sensitivity']*
45:                                        value[feature == 'localization'])
46:     cancers <- with(iset, size*sum(cancers))
47:     # expected lives saved
48:     lset <- gset %>% summarize(lives=value[feature == 'effect']*
49:                                      value[feature == 'sensitivity']*
50:                                      value[feature == 'localization']*
51:                                      value[feature == 'mortality'])
52:     lives <- with(lset, size*sum(lives))
53:     tibble(EUC=tests, CD=cancers, LS=lives)
